article.body_preview:
DHAKA, Jan 2, 2023 (BSS) - The general point to point inflation rate in

December last year eased further as it fell to 8.71 percentage point mainly

because of the downtrend in food and non-food inflation.

The general point to point inflation rate in November last was 8.85

percentage, according to the monthly consumer price (CPI) index of the

Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS).

The point to point food inflation came down at 7.91 percent in December from

8.14 percent in November.
